name: roofs_mixed_s
prompt:
Image 1 is the finished sheet; image 2 is its layout: 2 building outlines seen from above on flat magenta, in a 2×1 grid. Redraw cells 1 and 2 (the transparent areas). Keep everything else exactly as it is, and keep image 1's style, colours and fine detail.

Faults of the last attempt, to fix:
- Cell 1: the greenhouse was drawn about 16% too narrow (338 px wide for a 402 px wide outline), leaving magenta down both sides, and drawn like a tall glass tower in perspective. Fill the whole outline in image 2, edge to edge, 402 px wide. It is a low single-storey greenhouse seen from straight above: two flat glass roof slopes of equal width either side of one straight ridge line running from the bottom edge to the top edge, a regular grid of panes about 1 m apart on a light frame, no walls or floors seen.
- Cell 2: the roof ran past the outline's left edge, so its left parapet and the plant on that side were cut off. Keep the whole roof inside the outline: its parapet, about 0.4 m, runs round all four edges, and every unit stands wholly inside it, at least 1 m in from the parapet.

Trace each outline in image 2 exactly, straight square edges, top-down with no perspective, the magenta background flat pure #FF00FF outside. No text. Details at true size beside cars 4 m long: an air conditioner unit about 1–1.5 m, a chiller about 2 × 4 m, a lift room about 3 × 5 m.

1. 15.4 × 21.7 m (1.4× deeper than wide) — long greenhouse, gabled roof of glass or polycarbonate panels on a light frame, standing narrow end to the street with the entrance on that short front wall, its ridge running from the street to the back
2. 27.6 × 21.8 m (1.3× wider than deep) — mid-rise office or public building, flat roof of grey membrane with rooftop plant, a lift room and a parapet
